units.source_text: 每次老人想什么事情的时候，下巴额儿总是在动，

en.t: Whenever the old man was thinking about something, his chin was always moving,

units.source_text: 有时做工粗劣的全副假牙还会上下碰撞，发出了声音。

en.t: and sometimes his crudely made full set of dentures would knock together up and down, making a sound.

units.source_text: 他的假牙不合适，每天重复讲述的解说越来越让人听不清楚了。

en.t: His dentures did not fit, and the explanations he repeated every day became harder and harder to understand.

units.source_text: 尽管人们劝他去修理，他却一直也没有去矫正。

en.t: Although people urged him to have them repaired, he never went to have them adjusted.

units.source_text: 他凝望着菜园子，嘴里嘟哝着什么。

en.t: He gazed at the vegetable garden, muttering something under his breath.

units.source_text: 他一嘟哝，又发出了假牙的碰撞声。

en.t: As soon as he muttered, the dentures clattered together again.
Once the sound stopped, he began muttering again.

units.source_text: 大概是抱怨报警器修缮进展不顺利吧。

en.t: He was probably complaining that the repairs to the alarm system were not going smoothly.
